issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.title should be a String, but the solution's Book struct declares title as an Int. This type mismatch contradicts the specification and will confuse students about the intended type for the title field.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book struct's title property from Int to String (let title: String) so it matches the problem specification and typical usage.

issues.description: Within the solution repository there is an internal inconsistency: the Book struct declares title as Int, but Client assembles Book instances by passing String titles. This will cause compile errors and makes the solution invalid as a reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the types: update the Book struct to use let title: String so that Client's Book initializations with String titles compile, or alternatively adjust all Client usages to provide Int titles. Prefer changing Book.title to String to match the problem statement and expected usage.
